criteria.text: Before submission, pdd reads authenticated runtime capacity and waits through announced maintenance, showing its end and reason before rechecking.
When the server confirms that maintenance prevented a job from starting, pdd uses the same maintenance wait.
A runtime without the capacity endpoint can still accept work under its ordinary submission rules.
Maintenance waiting obeys the caller deadline and interruption.
Authentication, access and unrelated service errors retain their existing handling.

cases.given: capacity announces deploy until fixed future time, then clear
cases.required_observation: no POST during window; one POST after recheck; print reason/end

cases.given: window exceeds agent 90 s, separately interrupt
cases.required_observation: no later POST; finite wait and plain progress
existing immediate gate, no maintenance loop
